title: Detection of physical layer problems in RRC_CONNECTED

entities.name: DAPS bearer
entities.description: A bearer configuration where data forwarding is maintained during handover preparation.

entities.name: out-of-sync indication
entities.description: Indication from lower layers that radio link quality is below a threshold.

entities.name: N310
entities.description: Counter for consecutive out-of-sync indications from lower layers.

entities.name: source SpCell
entities.description: The special cell serving as the source in a handover scenario.

entities.name: T310
entities.description: Timer started upon detection of physical layer problems.

relations.description: DAPS bearer configuration enables the condition for monitoring out-of-sync indications.
Out-of-sync indications are counted by N310.
N310 counter is associated with the source SpCell.
T310 start is conditional on T304 running.
Receiving N310 consecutive out-of-sync indications starts timer T310.
